text.y01: [slowly] …Welcome, welcome. I'm Yuzu-jii, owner of this steamy hot spring.
text.y02: [warmly] Thank you for helping out today.
text.y03: [slowly] From the pipe on the left: hot water. Open it and steam comes from the left.
text.y04: [slowly] From the right: cold mountain water. The splash comes from the right.
text.y05: [warmly] Match each guest's favourite temperature, slowly. Feel it with your ears.
text.p01: [cheerful] Hello! I'm Pen the penguin! Almost cold water, please!
text.p03: [happy] Nice and chilly, just right! Thank you!
text.m01: [playful] Oh my, what a lovely spring! I like it HOT!
text.m02: [softly] …But this little one likes it lukewarm. Two baths, please.
text.m03: [laughs] Ahaha, perfect! See, you're happy too!
text.y06: [slowly] …Oh. Autumn rain. The water will cool down.
text.y07: [warmly] Add hot water and warm up in the steam. …The rain is cold, the steam is warm.
text.f01: [playful] Good day. I'm Kon the fox. Lukewarm and gentle, please, so my tail stays dry.
text.f03: [proud] Heh, just right. Isn't my tail fluffy?
text.y08: [slowly] …That's it for today. The last bath is yours.
text.y09: [warmly] Say the temperature you like. 'A little hotter' or 'a little cooler'.
text.y11: [slowly] …Come again. I'll be waiting, with the scent of yuzu.
